name: deadman-rises
description: A dead-man's switch for Claude Code: auto-resume long-running work after a session-limit stall, with an exact-time First/Second/Third Rise retry echelon, a durable Grave state file with a one-winner Seal, plain-English failure classification, Endless (loop) mode that ends itself when the work is done, and opt-in Death Watch auto-arm at ~80% of the 5-hour window (terminal only, per-conversation consent).
